text_mt: When midnight has arrived, the preceptor waits upon the planets: / "O fortunate one, give me fortune; O colorful one, give me color; O handsome one, give me form; O brilliant one, give me brilliance; O renowned one, give me renown; O mother of sons, give me sons; O possessor of all, bestow all desires upon me!"

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvamudita āditye vimale sumuhūrtte sūryapūjāpūrvakamardhyadānamupasthānaṃ ca namaste astu bhagavan śataraśme tamonuda jahi me deva daurbhagyaṃ saubhāgyena māṃ saṃyojayasva || iti |
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वमुदित आदित्ये विमले सुमुहूर्त्ते सूर्यपूजापूर्वकमर्ध्यदानमुपस्थानं च नमस्ते अस्तु भगवन् शतरश्मे तमोनुद जहि मे देव दौर्भग्यं सौभाग्येन मां संयोजयस्व ॥ इति ।
text_mt:
Thereafter, when the sun has risen clear at an auspicious hour, preceded by the worship of the Sun, the offering of water of honor and attendance take place [with the mantra]:

"Homage be to you, O lord of a hundred rays, dispeller of darkness! Slay my misfortune, O god, and unite me with good fortune!"
Then the satiation of the Brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast: yadi duḥsvapnaṃ paśyedvyāhṛtibhistilān hutvā diśā upatiṣṭhet | bodhaśca mā pratibodhaśca purastādgopāyatām | asvapnaśca mānavadrāṇaśca dakṣiṇato gopāyatām || gopāyamānaṃ ca māṃ rakṣamāṇaṃ ca paścād gopāyatām | jāgṛviśca mārundhatī cottarato gopāyatām || viṣṇuśca me pṛthivī ca nāgāścādhastādgopāyatām | bṛhaspatayaśca me viśve ca me devā dyauścopariṣṭhādgopāyatām |
meaning: यदि दुःस्वप्नं पश्येद्व्याहृतिभिस्तिलान् हुत्वा दिशा उपतिष्ठेत् । बोधश्च मा प्रतिबोधश्च पुरस्ताद्गोपायताम् । अस्वप्नश्च मानवद्राणश्च दक्षिणतो गोपायताम् ॥ गोपायमानं च मां रक्षमाणं च पश्चाद् गोपायताम् । जागृविश्च मारुन्धती चोत्तरतो गोपायताम् ॥ विष्णुश्च मे पृथिवी च नागाश्चाधस्ताद्गोपायताम् । बृहस्पतयश्च मे विश्वे च मे देवा द्यौश्चोपरिष्ठाद्गोपायताम् ।

text_mt: And likewise when any [omen] has occurred from which he might fear misfortunes.

sanskrit_iast: vyāhṛtibhistilān hutvā tapaḥ pratipadyeta dvādaśarātraṃ ṣaḍrātraṃ trirātramokarātraṃ vā |
meaning: व्याहृतिभिस्तिलान् हुत्वा तपः प्रतिपद्येत द्वादशरात्रं षड्रात्रं त्रिरात्रमोकरात्रं वा ।
text_mt: Having offered sesame seeds with the vyāhṛtis, he should undertake austerity for twelve nights, six nights, three nights, or one night.
Or if he considers [an event] a portentous occurrence, [he should perform] that [same rite].

sanskrit_iast: yadi parvasu mārtikaṃ bhidyate pārthivamāsi pṛthivīṃ dṛṃhasva yoniṃ gaccha svāhetyapsu praharet |
meaning: यदि पर्वसु मार्तिकं भिद्यते पार्थिवमासि पृथिवीं दृंहस्व योनिं गच्छ स्वाहेत्यप्सु प्रहरेत् ।
text_mt: If an earthen vessel is broken on the new- or full-moon days, he should throw [the shards] into the waters with: "You are of earth; strengthen the earth; go to your womb, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: yadyarcā dahyedvā naśyedvā prapatedvā prabhajedvā prahasedvā pracaledvā sthālyā vā sthālīmāsicya dakṣiṇottarā vā sthālī bhidyetottarā vopalāśe niyamya dvāravaṃśo vā sphuṭet | gaur vā gāṃ dhayet strī vā striyamāhanyāt kartasaṃsarge halasaṃsarge musalaprapatane musalaṃvāvaśīryetānyasmiṃścādbhuta etābhirjuhuyāt svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svastinaḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svastino bṛhaspatirdadhātu | svasti no mimītāmāśvinā bhagaḥ svasti devyaditiranarvaṇaḥ | svasti pūṣā asuro dadhātu naḥ svastidyāvāpṛthivī sucetunā || svastaye vāyumupabravāmahai somaṃ svasti bhuvanasya yaspatiḥ | bṛhaspatiṃ sarvagaṇaṃ svastaye svastaya ādityāso bhavantu naḥ || viśve devā no adyā svastaye vaiśvānaro vasurāgniḥ svastaye | devā avantvṛbhavaḥ svastaye svasti no rudraḥ pātvaṃhasaḥ || svasti naḥ paśyāsu dhanvasu svastyapsu vrajane svarvataḥ | svasti naḥ pathyākṛteṣu yoniṣu svasti rāye manuto dadhātu naḥ || trātāramindraṃ mā te asyāṃ vina indra mṛgo na bhīmastaṃ śaṃyorāvṛṇīmaha iti daśāhutayaḥ |
meaning: यद्यर्चा दह्येद्वा नश्येद्वा प्रपतेद्वा प्रभजेद्वा प्रहसेद्वा प्रचलेद्वा स्थाल्या वा स्थालीमासिच्य दक्षिणोत्तरा वा स्थाली भिद्येतोत्तरा वोपलाशे नियम्य द्वारवंशो वा स्फुटेत् । गौर् वा गां धयेत् स्त्री वा स्त्रियमाहन्यात् कर्तसंसर्गे हलसंसर्गे मुसलप्रपतने मुसलंवावशीर्येतान्यस्मिंश्चाद्भुत एताभिर्जुहुयात् स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवाः स्वस्तिनः पूषा विश्ववेदाः । स्वस्ति नस्तार्क्ष्यो अरिष्टनेमिः स्वस्तिनो बृहस्पतिर्दधातु । स्वस्ति नो मिमीतामाश्विना भगः स्वस्ति देव्यदितिरनर्वणः । स्वस्ति पूषा असुरो दधातु नः स्वस्तिद्यावापृथिवी सुचेतुना ॥ स्वस्तये वायुमुपब्रवामहै सोमं स्वस्ति भुवनस्य यस्पतिः । बृहस्पतिं सर्वगणं स्वस्तये स्वस्तय आदित्यासो भवन्तु नः ॥ विश्वे देवा नो अद्या स्वस्तये वैश्वानरो वसुराग्निः स्वस्तये । देवा अवन्त्वृभवः स्वस्तये स्वस्ति नो रुद्रः पात्वंहसः ॥ स्वस्ति नः पश्यासु धन्वसु स्वस्त्यप्सु व्रजने स्वर्वतः । स्वस्ति नः पथ्याकृतेषु योनिषु स्वस्ति राये मनुतो दधातु नः ॥ त्रातारमिन्द्रं मा ते अस्यां विन इन्द्र मृगो न भीमस्तं शंयोरावृणीमह इति दशाहुतयः ।
text_mt:
If an idol should burn, or be lost, or fall down, or break, or laugh, or move; or having poured from pot to pot, either the southern or the northern pot should break; or the door-beam fixed above the threshold should crack; or a cow should suckle a cow; or a woman should strike a woman; upon the meeting of an abyss; upon the collision of a plow; upon the falling of a pestle; or if a pestle should break; and in the case of any other portentous wonder, he should make offerings with these [verses]:

"May Indra of far-reaching fame grant us well-being; may Pūṣan, knower of all things, grant us well-being; / may Tārkṣya, with uninjured felly, grant us well-being; may Bṛhaspati grant us well-being.

May the Aśvins and Bhaga mete out well-being to us; may the goddess Aditi, of unimpeded course, grant well-being; / may Pūṣan the Asura grant us well-being; may Heaven and Earth with good counsel grant well-being.

For well-being let us invoke Vāyu, [and] Soma, who is lord of the world, for well-being; / [and] Bṛhaspati with all his host for well-being; may the Ādityas be for our well-being.

May the Viśvedevas be for our well-being today, and Agni Vaiśvānara, the Vasu, for well-being; / may the divine Ṛbhus protect us for well-being; may Rudra guard us against distress.

Well-being to us in our views, in the wastes; well-being in the waters, in our travels toward the heavenly realm; / well-being to us along paths made into homes; may [the lord] of devotion grant us well-being for wealth."
"Indra the deliverer...", "May we not in this...", "Indra, separate us...", "Like a dreadful beast...", "We choose the benevolence and blessings...": thus there are ten oblations.

sanskrit_iast: sarpebhyo bibhyat śrāvaṇyāṃ tūṣaṇīṃ bhaumamekakapālaṃśrapayitvākṣatasaktūn piṣṭvā svakṛta iriṇe darbhānāstīryācyutāya dhruvāya bhaumāya svāheti juhoti |
meaning: सर्पेभ्यो बिभ्यत् श्रावण्यां तूषणीं भौममेककपालंश्रपयित्वाक्षतसक्तून् पिष्ट्वा स्वकृत इरिणे दर्भानास्तीर्याच्युताय ध्रुवाय भौमाय स्वाहेति जुहोति ।
text_mt: One who fears serpents, on the full moon day of Śrāvaṇa, having silently cooked a cake on one potsherd dedicated to the Earth, and ground unbroken barley groats, having strewn darbha grass in a natural cleft of the ground, offers with: "To Acyuta, the firm, belonging to the Earth, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: samīci nāmāsīti paryāyairupatiṣṭhate pratidiśaṃ dvābhyāṃ madhye |
meaning: समीचि नामासीति पर्यायैरुपतिष्ठते प्रतिदिशं द्वाभ्यां मध्ये ।
text_mt: He worships with the successive verses beginning "Samīcī is your name..." in each direction, and with two in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: akṣatasaktūnāṃ sarpabaliṃ harati īśānāyetyeke sarpo 'si sarpāṇāmadhipatistvayi sarve sarpāḥ | balihāro 'stu sarpāṇāṃ namo astuṣurmāririṣurmāhiṃsiṣurmādāṃ si sarpāḥ || māno agne visṛjo adhāyā viṣyave ripave ducchunāyai | mā datvate daśate mādate no mā rīṣate sahasāvanparādāḥ || sarpo 'si sarpāṇāmadhipatiratnena manuṣyāṃ srāyase 'pūpena sarpān || tvayi santaṃ mayi santa mākṣiṣurmārīriṣurmā hiṃsiṣu mā dāṅkṣu sarpāḥ || namo astu sarpebhya iti tisṛbhiśca |
meaning: अक्षतसक्तूनां सर्पबलिं हरति ईशानायेत्येके सर्पो ऽसि सर्पाणामधिपतिस्त्वयि सर्वे सर्पाः । बलिहारो ऽस्तु सर्पाणां नमो अस्तुषुर्मारिरिषुर्माहिंसिषुर्मादां सि सर्पाः ॥ मानो अग्ने विसृजो अधाया विष्यवे रिपवे दुच्छुनायै । मा दत्वते दशते मादते नो मा रीषते सहसावन्परादाः ॥ सर्पो ऽसि सर्पाणामधिपतिरत्नेन मनुष्यां स्रायसे ऽपूपेन सर्पान् ॥ त्वयि सन्तं मयि सन्त माक्षिषुर्मारीरिषुर्मा हिंसिषु मा दाङ्क्षु सर्पाः ॥ नमो अस्तु सर्पेभ्य इति तिसृभिश्च ।
text_mt:
He brings an offering of unbroken barley groats to the serpents; "To Īśāna," say some.

"You are a serpent, the overlord of serpents; in you are all the serpents.

May there be a bringing of offerings to the serpents; homage be [to them]; may the serpents not harm, not injure, nor bite [us]!"

"Do not, O Agni, abandon us to the sinner, the treacherous enemy, the calamity; / do not surrender us, O mighty one, to the toothed, the biter, the destroyer, nor to the one who injures!"

"You are a serpent, the overlord of serpents; with this jewel you protect human beings, with the cake the serpents.

May the serpents residing in you, residing in me, not destroy, not injure, not harm, nor bite!"

And with the three [verses beginning] "Homage be to the serpents..."

[Saying,] "O firm one, I entrust so-and-so to you," he mentions all his family members by name, and himself.
Having brought the serpent-offering according to this rule for four months, he stops.
Even silently, with washed hands, [an offering] of small [food may be made].

sanskrit_iast: ayūthike bhayārtte kapote gṛhān praviṣṭe tasyājnau padaṃ dṛśyeta dadhāni sakatuṣu ghṛte vā devāḥ kapota iti pratyṛcaṃ japejjuhuyādvā devāḥ kapota iṣito yadicchandūto nirṛtyā idamājagāma | tasmā arcāma kṛṣṇavāma niṣkṛtiṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade || śivaḥ kapota iṣito no astvanāgā devāḥ śakuno gṛheṣu agnirhi vipro juṣatāṃ havirnaḥ parihetiḥ pakṣiṇo no vṛṇāktu || hetiḥ pakṣiṇī na dabhātyasmānāṣṭyāṃ padaṃ kṛṇute agnidhāne | saṃ no gobhyaśca puruṣebhyaścāstu māno hiṃsīdiha devāḥ kapotaḥ || yadulūko vadati moghametadyatkapotaḥ padamagnau kṛṇoti | yasya dūtaḥ prahita eṣa etattasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave || ṛcā kapotaṃ nudata pramodamiṣaṃ madantaḥ pari gāṃ nayadhvam | saṃyopayanto duritāni viśvā hitvā na ūrjaṃ prapatātpatiṣṭhaḥ || iti |
meaning: अयूथिके भयार्त्ते कपोते गृहान् प्रविष्टे तस्याज्नौ पदं दृश्येत दधानि सकतुषु घृते वा देवाः कपोत इति प्रत्यृचं जपेज्जुहुयाद्वा देवाः कपोत इषितो यदिच्छन्दूतो निरृत्या इदमाजगाम । तस्मा अर्चाम कृष्णवाम निष्कृतिं शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥ शिवः कपोत इषितो नो अस्त्वनागा देवाः शकुनो गृहेषु अग्निर्हि विप्रो जुषतां हविर्नः परिहेतिः पक्षिणो नो वृणाक्तु ॥ हेतिः पक्षिणी न दभात्यस्मानाष्ट्यां पदं कृणुते अग्निधाने । सं नो गोभ्यश्च पुरुषेभ्यश्चास्तु मानो हिंसीदिह देवाः कपोतः ॥ यदुलूको वदति मोघमेतद्यत्कपोतः पदमग्नौ कृणोति । यस्य दूतः प्रहित एष एतत्तस्मै यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे ॥ ऋचा कपोतं नुदत प्रमोदमिषं मदन्तः परि गां नयध्वम् । संयोपयन्तो दुरितानि विश्वा हित्वा न ऊर्जं प्रपतात्पतिष्ठः ॥ इति ।
text_mt:
When a pigeon, separated from its flock and afflicted with fear, has entered the house and its footprint should be seen in the fire, in curds, in groats, or in clarified butter, he should mutter or offer verse by verse [the verses beginning]: "O gods, the dove..." / "If the dove, sent as an envoy of Nirṛti, has come here seeking [harm],

To him let us sing praise, let us make atonement; may there be well-being for our two-footed, well-being for our four-footed!

Auspicious may the sent dove be to us, harmless, O gods, the bird in our houses! / For wise Agni shall enjoy our oblation; may the missile of the winged one bypass us!

May the winged missile not harm us; he makes his footprint on the hearth, in the fireplace! / May there be well-being for our cattle and our men; let the dove not injure us here, O gods!

In vain is what the owl hoots, that the dove makes a footprint in the fire; / to that Yama, to Death, whose messenger sent forth this [bird] is, let homage be!

With a verse drive away the dove, rejoicing; exulting in refreshment, lead the cow around! / Warding off all misfortunes, leaving strength for us, let the swiftest-flying bird fly away!"
Taking the footprint, they carry it toward the south-west.
They go along with the supporting objects.
Having cast down the footprint into a natural cleft of the ground, all over it,

sanskrit_iast: dhāmno dhāmna iti tisṛbhiḥ parogoṣṭhaṃ mārajayante |
meaning: धाम्नो धाम्न इति तिसृभिः परोगोष्ठं मारजयन्ते ।
text_mt: With the three [verses beginning] "From abode to abode...", they wipe themselves away from the cowpen.
Without looking back, they return.

sanskrit_iast: agna āyūṃṣi pavase agnirṛṣiragne pavasveti pratyetya japanti |
meaning: अग्न आयूंषि पवसे अग्निरृषिरग्ने पवस्वेति प्रत्येत्य जपन्ति ।
text_mt: Having returned, they mutter: "O Agni, you purify our life-spans...", "Agni is the seer...", and "O Agni, purify..."
One desirous of a son [performs] a six-oblation rite on the first day of the lunar fortnight.

sanskrit_iast: payasi sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā tasya juhoti brahmaṇāgniḥ saṃvidāno rakṣohā bādhātāmitaḥ | amī vā yaste garbhaṃ durṇāmā yonimāśaye | yaste garbhamamī vā durṇāmā yonimāśaye | agniṣṭhaṃ brahmaṇā saha niṣkramyādamanīnaśat || yaste hantī patayantaṃ niṣatsnuṃ yaḥ sarīsṛpam | jātaṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmasi || yastvā svapnena tamasā mohayitvā nipadyate | prajāṃyaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmasi || ye te ghnantyapso gandharvā goṣṭhāśca ye | kravyādaṃsura devinaṃ tamito nāśayāmasi || yasta ūru viharatyantarā dampatī śaye | yoniṃ yo antarāreḍhi tamito nāśayāmasi || abhinnāṇḍā vṛddhagarbhā ariṣṭhā jīvasūkarī | vijāyatāṃ prajāyatāmiyaṃ bhavatu tokinī || viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṃśatu | āsiñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te || garbhaṃ dhehi sītīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati | garbhaṃ te aśvinau devāvādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā || hiraṇyayī araṇīyaṃ nirmanthato aśvinā | taṃ te garbhaṃ havāmahe daśame māsi sūtave || paraṃ mṛtyo anuparehi panthāṃ yaste sva itaro devayānāt | cakṣuṣmate śṛṇavate te bravīmi mānaḥ prajāṃ rīriṣo mota vīrān || iti dvādaśagarbhavedinyaḥ ṣaḍādyāḥ sthālīpākasya ṣaḍutarā ājyasya |
meaning: पयसि स्थालीपाकं श्रपयित्वा तस्य जुहोति ब्रह्मणाग्निः संविदानो रक्षोहा बाधातामितः । अमी वा यस्ते गर्भं दुर्णामा योनिमाशये । यस्ते गर्भममी वा दुर्णामा योनिमाशये । अग्निष्ठं ब्रह्मणा सह निष्क्रम्यादमनीनशत् ॥ यस्ते हन्ती पतयन्तं निषत्स्नुं यः सरीसृपम् । जातं यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ॥ यस्त्वा स्वप्नेन तमसा मोहयित्वा निपद्यते । प्रजांयस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ॥ ये ते घ्नन्त्यप्सो गन्धर्वा गोष्ठाश्च ये । क्रव्यादंसुर देविनं तमितो नाशयामसि ॥ यस्त ऊरु विहरत्यन्तरा दम्पती शये । योनिं यो अन्तरारेढि तमितो नाशयामसि ॥ अभिन्नाण्डा वृद्धगर्भा अरिष्ठा जीवसूकरी । विजायतां प्रजायतामियं भवतु तोकिनी ॥ विष्णुर्योनिं कल्पयतु त्वष्टा रूपाणि पिंशतु । आसिञ्चतु प्रजापतिर्धाता गर्भं दधातु ते ॥ गर्भं धेहि सीतीवालि गर्भं धेहि सरस्वति । गर्भं ते अश्विनौ देवावाधत्तां पुष्करस्रजा ॥ हिरण्ययी अरणीयं निर्मन्थतो अश्विना । तं ते गर्भं हवामहे दशमे मासि सूतवे ॥ परं मृत्यो अनुपरेहि पन्थां यस्ते स्व इतरो देवयानात् । चक्षुष्मते शृणवते ते ब्रवीमि मानः प्रजां रीरिषो मोत वीरान् ॥ इति द्वादशगर्भवेदिन्यः षडाद्याः स्थालीपाकस्य षडुतरा आज्यस्य ।
text_mt:
Having cooked a pot-cooked offering in milk, he makes oblations of it:

"Agni, in accord with sacred speech, the slayer of demons, shall drive away from here / the disease or the ill-named [demon] that lies upon your womb, your embryo.

The disease or the ill-named [demon] that lies upon your womb, your embryo, / Agni, accompanied by sacred speech, stepping forth, has destroyed him.

He who slays your [embryo] that flies, that sits, that creeps, / he who seeks to slay what is born to you, him we banish from here.

He who lies down with you having bewildered you with sleep and darkness, / he who seeks to slay your offspring, him we banish from here.

Those Gandharvas of the waters and those of the cattle-pen who slay your [child], / the raw-flesh-eating demonic creature, him we banish from here.

He who parts your two thighs, who lies between husband and wife, / who licks within your womb, him we banish from here.

With intact egg, with fully-grown embryo, uninjured, bearing living young, / may she bring forth, may she give birth; may she be blessed with children.

May Viṣṇu prepare the womb; may Tvaṣṭṛ fashion the forms; / may Prajāpati pour in [the seed]; may Dhātṛ place the embryo in you!"

Sinīvālī, place an embryo! Sarasvatī, place an embryo! / May the two divine Aśvins, garlanded with blue lotuses, place an embryo in you!

This is the golden fire-stick which the two Aśvins churn out; / we invoke that embryo for you, to be born in the tenth month.

Go far along, Death, following another path which is your own, distinct from the path of the gods; / to you who have eyes and ears I speak: do not harm our offspring, nor our men!
These are the twelve [verses] announcing conception: the first six are for the pot-cooked offering, the latter six for clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: naijameṣaṃ sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā yathā ṣāḍāhutam nejameṣa parāpata suputraḥ punarāpata | asyai me putrakāmāyai punarādhehi yaḥ pumān || yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahyamuttānā garbhamādadhe | evaṃ taṃ garbhamādhehi daśame māsi sūtave || viṣṇoḥ śreṣṭhena rupeṇāsyāṃ nāryāṃ gavīnyām | pumāṃsaṃ putramādhehi daśame māsi sūtave || pākayajñānsamāsādya ekājyāmekabahirṣi | ekaṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ puryannānā satyapi daivate nānā satyapi daivate |
meaning: नैजमेषं स्थालीपाकं श्रपयित्वा यथा षाडाहुतम् नेजमेष परापत सुपुत्रः पुनरापत । अस्यै मे पुत्रकामायै पुनराधेहि यः पुमान् ॥ यथेयं पृथिवी मह्यमुत्ताना गर्भमादधे । एवं तं गर्भमाधेहि दशमे मासि सूतवे ॥ विष्णोः श्रेष्ठेन रुपेणास्यां नार्यां गवीन्याम् । पुमांसं पुत्रमाधेहि दशमे मासि सूतवे ॥ पाकयज्ञान्समासाद्य एकाज्यामेकबहिर्षि । एकं स्विष्टकृतं पुर्यन्नाना सत्यपि दैवते नाना सत्यपि दैवते ।
text_mt:
Having cooked a pot-cooked offering dedicated to Nejameṣa, as in the six-oblation rite—

Fly away, Nejameṣa, fly back bearing fine sons! / For this woman of mine who desires a son, place again [an embryo] that is male!

Just as this great earth, lying face upward, has received an embryo, / even so place that embryo [in her], to be born in the tenth month!

With the most excellent form of Viṣṇu, into the two groins of this woman / place a male son, to be born in the tenth month!

Having combined domestic sacrifices with a single clarified butter and single sacrificial grass, / one should perform a single Sviṣṭakṛt, even when the deities are different, even when the deities are different.
